summary_en: FY3/27 period-end dividend raised to 245.00 yen/share from prior forecast of 188.00 yen/share. Increase reflects upward revision of net profit to 14.0 billion yen (from 10.7 billion yen forecast) driven by semiconductor-related product sales exceeding plan and improved operating leverage. Payout ratio target 40%.
title_en: Notice regarding revision of earnings forecast and dividend forecast (dividend increase) for fiscal year ending March 2027
translation_en_brief: PILLAR Corporation's board on 6 August 2026 revised upward its FY3/27 (year ending 31 March 2027) earnings and dividend forecasts. Net profit attributable to parent shareholders was raised from 10.7 billion yen to 14.0 billion yen, reflecting stronger-than-expected sales of fluorine-based products for semiconductor and LCD manufacturing equipment (driven by semiconductor market recovery) and improved operating leverage in the electronics-related business segment, alongside steady sales in the industrial equipment business. The period-end dividend forecast was increased from 188.00 yen per share to 245.00 yen per share, based on the company's target consolidated payout ratio of 40%. The company treats shareholder profit return as a key management policy.
